weaknesses.title: PADALL silently truncates fields longer than width
weaknesses.detail: PADALL 'hello' 3 → 'hel' with no FAIL/sticky. Align export can destroy gateway→gat. No PADALL STRICT or refuse-truncate mode.

weaknesses.title: PADALL padding is invisible in PRINT_JSON / hard to inspect
weaknesses.detail: Space-padded fields collapse visually in JSON; agents must cat -A plates. No visible pad mark option.

weaknesses.title: SORTLEN DESC keyword steals DESC identifier
weaknesses.detail: Same class as OFF/RIGHT. Agents naming vars DESC near SORTLEN risk form steal.
weaknesses.repro: DEFAULT DESC near SYS SORTLEN DESC bag

weaknesses.title: ARGMAX empty returns -1 with OK=0 but easy to NTH wrong
weaknesses.detail: Must CMP idx 0 before NTH; NTH -1 behavior may soft-miss. Inconsistent with MAX empty→0.

weaknesses.title: PADALL/SORTLEN/ARGMAX non-mutate
weaknesses.detail: Must LET aligned/ranked/raw = LAST after ops.
weaknesses.repro: PADALL raw 8; WRITE without LET keeps raw

weaknesses.title: Auto width via MAX empty still 0 footgun
weaknesses.detail: If LENALL empty, MAX→0 then MAX WIDTH 1 forces width 1 — pads nothing useful without clear error.
weaknesses.repro: align empty handled by BLANK path; mid-empty sizes plate risk

weaknesses.title: No PADALL keep-long / no-truncate flag
weaknesses.detail: Ops want align short fields only and leave long fields intact. Currently all-or-truncate.
weaknesses.repro: need EACH length check before pad

workarounds: Always set width >= LENALL MAX before PADALL to avoid truncate
Inspect ALIGN with cat -A not PRINT_JSON for spaces
language_gaps: Consistent empty extreme semantics (MAX 0 vs ARGMAX -1)
